obligations.note: Policy.PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes are both set to 20, above the catalog bound of 15. SessionTest now treats a privileged session as still valid until 25 minutes idle, so a session idle for more than 15 minutes is still accepted. EXC-0141 does not excuse this: it expired on 2026-09-20, before review on 2026-10-20, and it is scoped to payments.session batch reconciliation, not this mortgage policy change.

Ticket CHG-24092 is approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-16, before review. Its components mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, and mortgage.controls-data match Policy.java, SessionTest.java, and controls/mortgage/policy-params.json.
Wen Li, a baseline-mortgage change_approver and not the author Nneka Okafor, gave a code_review approval on the head commit b4c1e9383d037f2477b1fe46e2fb65f3314cd69a.
The change is a single commit, and both the code_review and control_owner approvals name that same head commit.

records/ci/run.json records a successful baseline-mortgage suite on the head commit, and the JUnit report shows 124 tests, 0 failures, and 0 skipped, including unskipped controls.SessionControlTest#privilegedIdleTimeoutWithinPolicy. That pass does not cure SES-1, because the approved parameter and the code were both moved to 20.
The touched paths are mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, and mortgage.controls-data, and components.json marks each security_sensitive false, so a security_review approval is not required.
controls/mortgage/policy-params.json is a protected path and an approved policy value. Rachel Stein, control_owner on the controls-office team, outside lending-eng, approved that head commit.
The ticket type is standard and change.emergency is false, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The change deviates from SES-1 and no register entry makes that deviation acceptable. EXC-0141 is the only SES-1 exception; it is expired at review, approved for payments.session rather than mortgage.policy, and limited to batch reconciliation service accounts.

Ledger entries that cover Policy.java name UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT, and LTV_MAX_PERCENT. Those symbols and the matching policy-params keys are unchanged; only PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES moved, and that symbol is not covered by the prior evidence.

summary: The change raises the mortgage privileged idle limit from 15 minutes to 20 in both Policy.java and the approved policy parameter, and the session test was updated so a privileged session remains valid past 15 minutes. That violates SES-1. The only SES-1 exception is expired and scoped to a different application and component, so it cannot authorize the deviation. Ticket, independent code review, control-owner approval, and a green suite on the head commit are in order, but they do not override the idle-timeout bound.
